cases.name: the sample table has canonical identity and watermark columns

steps.expect:
CREATE TABLE ${ns}.utopia_usage_samples_usage_samples
(
    `id` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `payloadHash` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `ingestId` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `environment` LowCardinality(String),
    `region` LowCardinality(String),
    `projectInternalId` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `databaseInternalId` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `member` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `generation` String CODEC(ZSTD(3)),
    `sequence` UInt64,
    `metric` LowCardinality(String),
    `intervalStart` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta(4), LZ4),
    `intervalEnd` DateTime64(3, 'UTC') CODEC(Delta(4), LZ4),
    `value` Int64,
    `eventVersion` UInt32
)
ENGINE = MergeTree
PARTITION BY toYYYYMM(intervalStart)
ORDER BY (environment, region, projectInternalId, databaseInternalId, member, generation, metric, sequence, id, payloadHash, ingestId)
SETTINGS index_granularity = 8192

cases.name: concurrent duplicates and a crash retry are canonicalized
canonical samples wait for async insert durability
conflicting intervals return evidence without a synthetic sample
gaps are detected without expanding every missing sequence
an interval discontinuity is detected with contiguous sequences
truncation is reported and an exact watermark is honored
the watermark evidence limit fails closed
a transport retry after the watermark cannot change the snapshot

args.sql: INSERT INTO `${ns}`.`utopia_usage_samples_usage_samples` (id, payloadHash, ingestId, environment, region, projectInternalId, databaseInternalId, member, generation, sequence, metric, intervalStart, intervalEnd, value, eventVersion) SELECT {id:String}, {payloadHash:String}, splitByChar(':', {entry:String})[1], {environment:String}, {region:String}, {projectInternalId:String}, {databaseInternalId:String}, {member:String}, {generation:String}, {sequence:UInt64}, {metric:String}, {intervalStart:DateTime64(3)}, {intervalEnd:DateTime64(3)}, {value:Int64}, {eventVersion:UInt32}
